say:1:1033105001:1.text: More or less. He's still got a little cough, but nothing to worry about. All thanks to those kind Wilders!
say:1:1033105001:1.source_cn: 差不多了，只是还有一点咳嗽，不要紧。多亏了那些好心的绿...
say:1:1033105001:1.male: More or less. He's still got a little cough, but nothing to worry about. All thanks to those kind Wilders!
say:1:1033105001:1.female: More or less. He's still got a little cough, but nothing to worry about. All thanks to those kind Wilders!

say:2:1033105002:1.text: They brought lots of herbs, some of which I'd never even heard of but were more useful than what we'd tried before!
say:2:1033105002:1.source_cn: 他们拿来了不少草药，有一些我连听都没听说过，但是却比我...
say:2:1033105002:1.male: They brought lots of herbs, some of which I'd never even heard of but were more useful than what we'd tried before!
say:2:1033105002:1.female: They brought lots of herbs, some of which I'd never even heard of but were more useful than what we'd tried before!

say:3:1033105003:1.text: Look, it hasn't been long and Patrick's already back to his lively self.
say:3:1033105003:1.source_cn: 你看，这才没多久，小派瑞克就活蹦乱跳的了。
say:3:1033105003:1.male: Look, it hasn't been long and Patrick's already back to his lively self.
say:3:1033105003:1.female: Look, it hasn't been long and Patrick's already back to his lively self.

say:4:1033105004:0.text: I heard it was because of their continued opposition to the exclusion edict of the Dark Forest that Lyca and Eironn were finally able to lift it, allowing us to enter.
say:4:1033105004:0.source_cn: 听说也是因为他们一直反对，薄暮丛林才解除了封锁令，允许...
say:4:1033105004:0.male: I heard it was because of their continued opposition to the exclusion edict of the Dark Forest that Lyca and Eironn were finally able to lift it, allowing us to enter.
say:4:1033105004:0.female: I heard it was because of their continued opposition to the exclusion edict of the Dark Forest that Lyca and Eironn were finally able to lift it, allowing us to enter.

say:5:1033105005:1.text: The Wilders are just like they're rumored to be: kind and good. We just misunderstood.
say:5:1033105005:1.source_cn: 绿裔果然和传闻里一样，又善良又亲切，以前都是我们误会了。
say:5:1033105005:1.male: The Wilders are just like they're rumored to be: kind and good. We just misunderstood.
say:5:1033105005:1.female: The Wilders are just like they're rumored to be: kind and good. We just misunderstood.

say:6:1033105006:1.text: After we enter the forest, we'll definitely do our best to get along to repay them for all their kindness!
say:6:1033105006:1.source_cn: 等我们进入森林，一定和他们好好相处，回报这份恩情的！
say:6:1033105006:1.male: After we enter the forest, we'll definitely do our best to get along to repay them for all their kindness!
say:6:1033105006:1.female: After we enter the forest, we'll definitely do our best to get along to repay them for all their kindness!
